entries.german:
Die Brüder Heinrich und Wok von Krumau, bestätigen die Schenkung ihres Vaters Witiko und bezeugen, daß sie auf die Kirche von Kirchschlag, die drei Mansen im Pfarrdorf (in foro) und auf das Dorf Pfaffenschlag (Phaphenslag) keinen Anspruch haben.

"In nomine Domini. Amen. Acta solempniter delet obliuio, nisi literarum fulciantur stabili firmamento. Inde est, quod nos Henricus(1) et Woko(2) dicti de Crumnaw, notum esse volumus omnibus presentes audituris literas seu visuris, quod pater noster dominus Witko(3) felicis memorie dedit et contulit domui beate virginis in Plaga, Patauiensis dyocesis, pro damnis illatis et remedio anime sue ecclesiam in Kyrchslag(4) cum tribus mansis ibidem in foro(5) ad dotem spectantibus, et villam, que dicitur Phaphenslag(6), pleno iure et omni libertate, nullis pactis et condicionibus interpositis, libere et absolute in perpetuum possidendam. Nos ergo predicti Henricus et Woko donactionem [!] patris nostri ratam habentes, prescriptam ecclesiam in Kyrchslag cum tribus mansis ibidem et cum predicta villa Phaphenslag cum omnibus supra dictis libertatibus damus et confirmamus iam dicte domui beate virginis in Plaga perpetualiter possidendam. Vt uero nulli super hiis dubium oriatur, quia nullam habemus plane iusticiam, nec aliquis heredum sev successorum nostrorum habere poterit seu debebit in sepe dicta ecclesia in Kyrchslag aut in bonis ipsius supra dictis siue in iudicijs sev exactionibus uel in alijs quibuscunque grauaminibus faciendis, nisi quod sine omni vtilitate et eciam grauamine plebani, quemcunque prepositus superius fate domus beate virginis de Plaga ibi locauerit, sicut bona propria tenebimus fideliter defensare. Si autem, quod absit, per nos aut per aliquem successorum nostrorum secus actum fuerit uel attemptatum, multociens dictus prepositus et fratres domus beate virginis de Plaga resistere poterint et debebunt presencium testimonio literarum. Ut autem prescripta robur habeant firmitatis, presentes literas dedimus domui beate virginis in Plaga et fratribus ibidem, sigillo solius domini Wokonis, quia ego Henricus sigillo careo, apensione fideliter roboratas. Datum anno Domini Mo. CCo. octagesimo tercio, VIIIo. jdus junij. Testes sunt frater Henricus Lugerius(7), Radosta de Malocin(8), Senko de Cipin(9), Nemoy de Clenye(10), Vlricus Puchler(11), Ewerhardus calwus(12), W[ern]hardus Oder(13) et alij quam plures."

Siegel: Siegel an Pergamentbändchen hängend: Wok von Krumau. Braunes Wachs, dreieckig, 45 x 40 mm. Wappen: Nach rechts gehender Löwe mit Schwanz; rechts die fünfblättrige Rose an langem Stiel (Siebmachers Wappen unbek.). Umschrift: "+ S h.... vokkoni de crumlov"
entries.english:
The brothers Heinrich and Wok of Krumau confirm the donation of their father Witiko and testify that they have no claim to the church of Kirchschlag, the three manses in the parish village (in foro), or the village of Pfaffenschlag (Phaphenslag).

"In the name of the Lord. Amen. Solemn acts are erased by forgetfulness unless supported by the firm backing of letters. Hence we, Heinrich(1) and Woko(2), called of Krumau, wish it to be known to all who hear or see these present letters that our father, lord Witko(3) of happy memory, gave and granted to the house of the Blessed Virgin in Plášť (Plaga), Diocese of Passau, for damages suffered and for the remedy of his soul, the church at Kirchschlag(4) with three manses there in the market place(5) belonging to the dowry, and the village called Phaphenslag(6), with full right and all liberties, without any pact or condition interposed, to be held freely and absolutely in perpetuity. We therefore, the aforesaid Heinrich and Woko, accepting our father's donation as ratified, give and confirm the aforementioned church at Kirchschlag with three manses there and with the said village of Phaphenslag, together with all the liberties above mentioned, to the already named house of the Blessed Virgin in Pláž to be held perpetually. But that no doubt may arise concerning these matters among anyone, since we have plainly no jurisdiction, nor shall any of our heirs or successors have or ought to have in the aforesaid church at Kirchslag or in the goods aforesaid, or in judgments or exactions, or in any other burdens whatsoever, except that without any utility and even burden to the parish priest, whomever the superior prelate of the house of the Blessed Virgin of Pláž shall appoint there, we shall faithfully defend as our own proper goods. But if, God forbid, through us or through any of our successors anything should be done or attempted contrary to this, the said prepositus and the brothers of the house of the Blessed Virgin of Pláž may and ought to resist by the testimony of these present letters. That the aforesaid matters may have firm strength, we have given these letters to the house of the Blessed Virgin in Pláž and the brothers there, strengthened with the seal of only lord Wok (since I, Heinrich, lack a seal), and pledged our faithfulness. Given in the year of the Lord 1283, on the eighth day before the Ides of June [6 June]. Witnesses are: Brother Heinrich Lugerius(7), Radosta of Malčice(8), Senko of Čepín(9), Nemoy of Klensko(10), Ulrich Puchler(11), Everhard Calvus(12), Werner Oder(13), and many others."

Seal: Seal hanging from a parchment ribbon: Wok of Krumau. Brown wax, triangular, 45 x 40 mm. Arms: A lion walking to the right with tail; to the right, a five-petalled rose on a long stem (coat of arms unknown in Siebmacher). Legend: + S [SIGILLUM] VOKKONI DE CRUMLOV (Seal of Wok of Krumlov).
